interpretation: Necessary endpoint compatibility with independently free slopes. Marginal factor overlap permits distinct per-case anchors/quotients. No calendar candidate, identified source seconds, institutional rule or new holdout.

publicExport.omitted: Only diagnostic witness/contradiction details omitted; exact bounds, endpoint closure and status retained. Original reports remain preserved privately.

frozenPlan.scope: Retrospective necessary-condition diagnosis on all 28 exposed northern city-years. No calendar/API requests, no institutional contact, no timing default change.

domain.anchorDomain: closed continuous interval around unchanged autumn anchor b, including two no-gap June21 cases as relaxed diagnoses
domain.horizons: exact stored binary-rational adjusted sunrise R and sunset S, linearly interpolated at rational model-day knots

frozenPlan.observations: Reused model-labelled autumn Fajr and Isha source-minute cells; same half-open nearest-minute cells. Both already archived date interpretations must give identical selected cells/constraints; retain all empty cases and trims separately.
frozenPlan.constraints: Bf=R-q*N*k, Bi=S+q*N, N=1440+R-S. A=R-Bf>0, D=Bi-S in (0,N); k=A/D; q=D/N. Each event has an independently free affine slope. No outer crossing or full calendar is inferred from feasible endpoints.
questions: For k=18/16 and free q, compute exact feasible t unions per case and common displacement across all cases.
Project every case onto all k possible with SOME t and q in declared domains, intersect across all cases; this permits different t and q per case, NOT a universal anchor rule.
Retain the coupled q interval at sampled t and k and its exact formula per feasible piece; never multiply independent marginal ranges to claim joint feasibility.
Replay every one of 588 previous integer-shift factor intervals and previous fixed-q/k feasible-anchor memberships as necessary inclusion controls.
frozenPlan.arithmetic: Build exact piecewise-affine endpoint projection envelopes of feasible affine-line polygons. Split at envelope knots, horizon knots, physical clipping intersections and required constraint crossings. Ratio bounds on each open piece are linear-fractional with monotone or constant extrema; retain open endpoints, attainable flat extrema, isolated points, empty inputs and finite unions. No numerical epsilon or grid-only nonexistence claims.
frozenPlan.gate: A new full-calendar candidate may be tested only after a separately frozen plan and a documented untested general rule from the parallel local evidence audit. Diagnostic fits/locations/quotients are never installed. All candidates must be compared to the unchanged baseline over all six events and all 28 years, both date interpretations, with full regressions and unavailable counts. If no justified candidate exists, publish the narrowed feasible sets and limitation, not invented timing gains.
validation: Source-free synthetic tests for joint q intersection, moving ratio extrema/flat extrema, endpoint ties and disconnected feasible sets.
Independent exact point oracle at rational partition endpoints, midpoints and nearby points; independent reviewer repeats extraction and membership checks.
Retrospective reused inputs do not become a blind holdout or prove worldwide equality.
